# Device frames (1)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **android-frame** (AndroidFrame): A modern Android phone drawn in CSS: satin frame in porcelain, obsidian or sage, centered punch-hole camera, Material-style status bar and gesture or three-button… Not for: iPhone mockups (phone-frame).
